area: Squirrel HUD Charge card (Assets/_Scripts/UI) and Docs/REFACTOR_BACKLOG.md C2
summary: The Squirrel's Charge card is now a speed gauge with the minimum joust speed marked the way the Rhino marks Momentum (generated in SquirrelVesselHUDView.EnsureGeneratedAbilityIcons, bound through a new VesselHUDView.BindGeneratedAbilityGauge). Backlog C2 is marked resolved: the Scarab's Charge moved to its shove cooldown on Scarab.prefab, so no hull's Charge row sits where element_ability_table.py cannot see it.
